Overview.Name: Sathwik
Overview.Food_Habit: I can eat one bite and stop
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), Mental wellbeing & stress reduction
Overview.Preference_Notes: Balanced – include non-veg but not in every meal

Meal_1: Option 1: Egg bhurji (2 eggs) & small bowl cooked rice
Option 3: Curd rice (small bowl cooked rice & curd & salt)
Meal_2: Option 1: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & chicken curry (pressure-cooked)
Option 2: Cooked rice (1 cup cooked ~150 g) & dal (simple) & curd (small cup)
Option 3: Cooked rice (smaller portion) & paneer curry (pan-cooked)
Meal_3: Option 1: Fish curry (simple) & small bowl cooked rice

Notes_and_Tips: For a leaner look: keep rice around 1 cup cooked (~150 g) per main meal and make protein the main at each meal.
Boredom eating: keep snack pre-decided (murmura or makhana) and avoid eating directly from packets.
Add daily movement: 10-minute walk after one main meal supports digestion and stress.
Bedtime (optional): warm turmeric milk (small cup, no sugar) or warm water.
SIMS / nutrition theory note: protein-first meals and steady timing improve satiety and mood stability.
Keep cooking simple: pressure-cooked curries and pan-cooked omelettes work best.
